security_audit.summary: The command findings are Markdown paths, and the entropy findings reflect readable Chinese text. A reference offers underspecified stone wall attachment advice that could create a physical safety risk.

remediation.issue: Stone wall attachment guidance lacks safety conditions.
remediation.suggestion: Require a qualified installer to assess slab weight, substrate, anchors, adhesive specifications, and local requirements.

static_findings.snippet: 本 Skill 内置从学到装|装修课堂知识库,以下文件位于 `references/` 目录(共 27 篇,按场景分 5 组):
1. `ref-001.md` — 橱柜石材 6 大做法要点(垫板 vs 垫条 / 外飘不飘 / 翻沿 / 高低台 / 与高柜衔接 / 挡水条)
2. `ref-002.md` — 装修橱柜台面到底哪一种好
3. `ref-003.md` — 7 种橱柜台面,取决于颜值和钱包
4. `ref-004.md` — 厨房台面石英石和岩板,选哪个
5. `ref-005.md` — 橱柜台面,石英石下垫板够结实了
6. `ref-006.md` — 橱柜台面舍去 5 公分,获得更多便利
7. `ref-007.md` — 留还是不留?橱柜台面挡水和下挂的真相(后挡水一无是处、前挡水需下挂且独立收费、柜内进深测算)
8. `ref-008.md` — 橱柜台面高低不同,不用弯腰了
9. `ref-009.md` — 水槽翻车,多半殃及石材(水槽与台面衔接、台下盆提前告知)
10. `ref-010.md` — 石英石太糟心了,所以有钱还是不锈钢台面
- `ref-011.md` — 干区定制浴柜石材,6 种做法
- `ref-012.md` — 浴柜定制,各种台面的做法
- `ref-013.md` — 定制浴柜,记得延长台面
- `ref-014.md` — 干区和阳台石材上翻,省钱还能解决溅水问题
- `ref-015.md` — 岩板用到哪都行,慎选一体盆(岩板台中盆/无缝盆易脱胶开裂)
- `ref-016.md` — 窗台面选石英石、大理石还是岩板,要不要留"小耳朵"(材质对比 + 6 种做法 + 耳朵/顺序/趋势)
- `ref-017.md` — 家里窗台石的 6 种做法
- `ref-018.md` — 窗台石都极简了,你还在做耳朵
- `ref-019.md` — 家里窗户石材,两边必须有耳朵吗
- `ref-020.md` — 极简窗台石,无下挂,无耳朵,越看越好看
- `ref-021.md` — 装修房子,窗台铺什么材料好(石材/窗套/木板/马赛克/瓷砖)
- `ref-022.md` — 飘窗后期铺垫子,那铺石材干啥(飘窗用瓷砖更实惠)
- `ref-023.md` — 窗户窗台翻车集锦,自己家装修可以借鉴
- `ref-024.md` — 做石材电视墙,装有质感的家
- `ref-025.md` — 钟爱石材电视墙,随便挑一款搞定装修
- `ref-026.md` — 警惕!石英石翻车,后果比你想的严重(接缝/渗色/纹路随机/岩板开裂/台中盆/无缝盆)
- `ref-027.md` — 瓷砖石材购买支招()
- 问橱柜台面 / 石英石 vs 岩板 / 挡水 / 下挂 / 高低台 / 垫板 / 水槽衔接 → 读「一、橱柜台面石材」`ref-001.md`~`ref-010.md`
- 问浴柜台面 / 干区 / 阳台石材上翻 / 岩板一体盆 → 读「二、浴柜干区台面」`ref-011.md`~`ref-015.md`
- 问窗台石 / 飘窗 / 耳朵 / 窗台铺什么材料 → 读「三、窗台石与飘窗」`ref-016.md`~`ref-023.md`
- 问石材电视墙 / 背景墙 → 读「四、背景墙石材」`ref-024.md`~`ref-025.md`
- 问石英石翻车 / 材料选购避坑 → 读「五、材料选择与避坑」`ref-026.md`~`ref-027.md`
- `references/` 下全部 27 个文件均可按需读取,优先匹配用户问题主题

semantic_findings.title: Underspecified stone wall attachment advice
semantic_findings.description: The reference suggests directly bonding a stone slab to a wooden substrate without specifying load, adhesive, or support requirements. Improper installation could cause a slab to detach.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The recommendation is explicit, but actual safety depends on the slab, substrate, adhesive, and installation conditions.

content.value_statement: Stone selection and installation details can be difficult to compare. This guide uses renovation references to explain options and common pitfalls.
actual_capabilities: Compare quartz, sintered stone, marble, and stainless steel for different uses.
Explain kitchen countertop support, edges, backsplashes, and sink coordination.
Discuss bathroom countertop and integrated basin tradeoffs.
Compare window sill materials and edge details.
Summarize stone feature wall ideas and purchasing pitfalls.
limitations: Recommendations depend on a Chinese-language renovation reference collection.
Some source articles contain conflicting opinions and claims.
The skill cannot inspect materials or verify installation conditions.
It does not replace manufacturer instructions, local codes, or qualified installers.

use_cases.title: Compare Kitchen Countertops
use_cases.description: Compare materials and edge details for a planned kitchen.

use_cases.title: Plan Window Sills
use_cases.description: Explore sill materials and edge finishes for a renovation.

use_cases.title: Prepare Installation Questions
use_cases.description: Identify support, sink, and seam topics to discuss before fabrication.

prompt_templates.title: Start With Materials
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare quartz and sintered stone for my kitchen countertop.

prompt_templates.title: Specify Your Space
prompt_templates.prompt: Suggest window sill materials for a sunny room with a limited budget.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my bathroom vanity plan: [materials and dimensions]. Explain basin and countertop risks.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Contractor Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these countertop options: [options]. List tradeoffs, installation questions, source disagreements, and points requiring professional verification.

output_examples.input: What should I consider when choosing a kitchen countertop?
output_examples.output: Compare budget, stain resistance, impact resistance, seams, and support. Confirm installation details with the fabricator.

output_examples.input: Should a window sill have projecting ends?
output_examples.output: Consider whether a window surround needs an edge finish. A sill without projecting ends may suit a minimal design.

best_practices: Describe the room, budget, dimensions, and expected use.
Ask for relevant references and note conflicting source claims.
Check installation details with a qualified professional and the product manufacturer.
anti_patterns: Do not assume one material is best for every location.
Do not treat reference opinions as verified product specifications.
Do not install heavy stone based only on a general description.

faq.question: What spaces does this guide cover?
faq.answer: It covers kitchens, bathroom vanities, window sills, and stone feature walls.

faq.question: Which materials can it compare?
faq.answer: It discusses quartz, sintered stone, marble, stainless steel, and other countertop or sill options.

faq.question: Does it provide installation advice?
faq.answer: It explains common details and pitfalls. A qualified installer must assess the actual site.

faq.question: Can it estimate my project cost?
faq.answer: It can discuss budget tradeoffs, but it cannot provide a verified local quote.

faq.question: Are its references current product specifications?
faq.answer: No. Check current manufacturer documentation and local requirements.

faq.question: What should I include in my question?
faq.answer: Include the location, materials, budget, dimensions, and any sink or edge details.
